overview_description.description: Devoted Health is a healthcare company on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for every person like family. To accomplish this, Devoted Health has designed and built an integrated healthcare solution that combines Devoted Health Medicare Advantage plans, access to top local providers alongside virtual and in-home care delivered by Devoted Medical, full-service guides, and world-class technology that powers it all.

about_short_description.short_description: Devoted Health is a healthcare company serving seniors and giving them a health care plan with personal guides and world-class technology.

product.name: Medicare Advantage Plans
product.description: Health insurance plans for seniors that provide Medicare benefits including hospital, medical, and prescription drug coverage.

product.name: Food & Home Card
product.description: A monthly allowance card for eligible members to purchase groceries, over-the-counter items, and certain housing costs.

product.name: Dental & Eyewear Card
product.description: A yearly allowance card for dental care and eyewear purchases usable at any provider accepting MasterCard.

product.name: Prescription Drug Coverage
product.description: Part D prescription drug coverage included in most plans, with options starting at $0 copay.

product.name: Gym Membership Benefit
product.description: A membership providing access to thousands of gyms across the U.S. at no additional cost to members.

product.name: Primary Care Doctor Visits
product.description: Coverage for $0 copay visits to primary care doctors included in the Medicare Advantage plans.
